messages:
aashna: Pushed a quick mock of a 'traffic heatmap' for the rollout timeline in Figma -> https://figma.com/file/xxxx. Idea: show dense traffic areas across versions so you can eyeball where users hit and where canaries overlap. Preview screenshot attached.
sam: Nice — helps spot collision windows. Quick q: does heatmap represent absolute requests or percent of route traffic? which should it be?
josh: +1 on percent, absolute bars would skew when overall traffic varies. Percent makes it easier to compare canaries across times.
aashna: Agreed — percent by default, but hover shows raw req/s. Also thinking of a toggle: % vs raw. Hover tooltip would say: "12% (1.2k r/s) — cohort: mobile-web"
maria: Love the hover. Two accessibility/announce notes: 1) the heatmap cells need semantic labels for screen readers; 2) color-only indication is risky for colorblind folks.
aashna: Good calls. For SR we can expose a condensed text summary in an aria-live region when you focus a cell: e.g., "10:43 — Version v1.4: 12% traffic, canary A". For colorblind add a pattern overlay and a prominence indicator (bold border) for active canary.
sam: For the rollback affordance — current mock shows a small undo icon over the timeline. Concern: it might be too easy to trigger from misclicks. Maybe require a two-step: click opens rollback panel + confirm button. Also keyboard shortcut support.
josh: Two-step sounds right. For inline flow could we add a small "safety shield": click icon -> mini modal with reason dropdown + "Confirm rollback". This modal should also show affected variants and traffic shift preview.
aashna: I can add a confirmation modal with change preview. UX question: should we surface estimated user impact (latency/cost delta) in that modal? It could help decision-making but might add noise.
maria: Yes but make it optional collapse section. Keep SR: when modal opens, focus trap and aria-modal, then announce summary via aria-live: "Rollback preview: will reroute 80% of traffic from v2 -> v1. Estimated 3% latency decrease." :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy suggestion: canary rollback requires 2FA for prod workspaces — reminder for design copy: include a short line about required permissions and 2FA before "Confirm".
aashna: Thanks bot. I'll iterate the mock: add toggle %/raw, pattern overlays, hover raw numbers, confirmation modal with collapsed impact section, SR copy for aria-live. Will post updated Figma in ~2 hours.
sam: Perfect. Minor microcopy nit: change "Confirm rollback" -> "Confirm and rollback traffic" to avoid ambiguity.
josh: Also add an undo window copy in the timeline: "Undo available for 5 minutes" so people know they can revert quickly.
aashna: Noted — will include both copy changes. Leaving this thread open for any other nits before I update the file.
thread_summary: Design thread about adding a traffic heatmap to rollout timeline, percent vs raw toggle, accessibility labels and aria-live summaries, and a safer rollback confirmation modal with impact preview and copy nits.
